acceptance: Build one pure deterministic DispatchPlan from one task head, one runtime snapshot and one cached account-health snapshot. It alone decides dependency readiness, actor role, assignment, capacity, priority and dispatch generation.
Normal and claim-agent operation must consume the same plan. Review and finalize are ordinary roles in the same planner; routine reviewer or owner fallback must not wait for chair.

Use explicit enabled state plus global, account and agent capacities. Zero always means zero; it may never be clamped to one or treated as unlimited. Normalize provider aliases before planning and use one health record per real auth/quota account.

Fill every safe available slot until there is no runnable task or no eligible capacity. Never exceed shared account caps, duplicate a task generation, preempt a valid execution lease or bypass Human/Ops and reviewer-independence gates.
Keep chair only for explicit governance exceptions. Provider unavailability, quota retry, routine reassignment and deterministic worker recovery are not chair decisions.

Replace current dispatch_ready_tasks, task_execution_dispatch_candidate, higher_priority_ready_task_exists and assignment planning callers with the one planner. Delete dispatch_priority_for_task, current_dispatch_event_key, agent_has_dispatchable_primary_work, chair_reassignment_triage_needed_for_task and rewrite/legacy flags and fallbacks.

Replace worker_matches_current_assignment routing guesses with exact execution-lease generation validation. scripts/explain_dispatch.py must call the same planner and return the first real rejection reason.

Test multiple runnable roots, review/finalize priority, true dependency chains, owner/reviewer failover, shared quota, auth recovery, disabled and zero capacity, legacy ready migration, catalog routing changes, Human/Ops gates and full-slot utilization within two fast ticks.

Do not copy PR #4755's blanket removal of admission checks or task_assignment_is_catalog_locked returning False. Replace the authority boundary and delete the conflicting paths. Deliver by clean PR, independent exact-head review and required checks.
